# Romain Piau

> Portfolio of Romain Piau, a developer who builds desktop applications, developer tools and Minecraft projects, from the first idea to production. The site is available in English and French.

I mostly work with TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Electron and Node.js, plus Python, Java and Kotlin. My public repositories are listed on the site and stay in sync with GitHub.

## Pages

- [Portfolio (English)](https://romainpiau.dev/en/): featured projects, all public repositories, tech stack and contact
- [Portfolio (French)](https://romainpiau.dev/fr/): the same content in French

## Featured projects

- [Modding Manager](https://github.com/WolfGang-PRoxa/minecraft-modding-manager): Windows app (TypeScript, Electron, React) that installs Minecraft modpacks published on GitHub into CurseForge in one click and updates them without losing worlds or settings. Its built-in Studio helps authors publish to GitHub, CurseForge, Modrinth and Hangar.
- [CV Studio](https://github.com/WolfGang-PRoxa/cv): desktop app (Electron) to keep one master résumé and generate tailored variants, with a visual editor and PDF or HTML export.
- [Undercover](https://github.com/WolfGang-PRoxa/undercover-scriptable): the Undercover party game for iPhone, built for the Scriptable app.
